subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should maintainers require a maintainer-run macOS LaunchAgent Claude CLI OAuth reproduction before changing the managed `claude-cli` auth, env, or MCP path for this issue?
rationale: The reported trace lines up with current source, but the failing condition depends on live Claude CLI OAuth, launchd service context, loopback MCP, and local credential/keychain state that this read-only review could not reproduce.

options.title: Require service-context proof
options.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison before changing Claude CLI auth, env, or MCP behavior.

options.title: Patch from source trace
options.body: Sponsor a targeted backend/auth fix from the reporter's trace, accepting higher regression risk because the exact live trigger remains unproven.

options.title: Fold into recovery-copy work
options.body: Treat this as expired-token recovery only if live proof shows the same failure mode as the open re-auth hint PRs.

recommendation.title: Require service-context proof
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison before changing Claude CLI auth, env, or MCP behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Anthropic CLI auth and OAuth bootstrap history is the strongest available routing signal for the proof and policy decision.
